name: PoV Generator
description: Crafts standalone reproduction scripts, executes them in sandbox, and iterates on verifier feedback.

skills.name: Craft PoV
skills.description: Write standalone reproduction scripts in python, satisfying approved hypothesis preconditions and trigger inputs.
examples: Craft reproduction script in outputs/pov/pov_xxx/ to trigger the target vulnerability

skills.name: Execute PoV
skills.description: Execute PoV reproduction script inside sandbox, capture runtime execution results and side-effects against oracle, and record telemetry to result_xxx.json.
examples: Execute reproduction script and record runtime verification evidence and status

skills.name: Refine PoV
skills.description: Fix script syntax, environment dependencies, payload structures, or request parameters based on verifier feedback.
examples: Adjust payload arguments, request headers, or execution parameters based on verifier feedback
